description:
intent=i045 snapshot=s02 branch=hardirq-shared-lock status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/mediatek/mtk_star_emac.c:769-786 confidence=high conclusion=mtk_star_emac.c hardirq mtk_star_handle_irq (request_irq:1001) takes priv->lock plainly at 782 while NAPI polls (softirq, hard IRQs enabled) take the same lock plainly at 1185/1351 with no irqsave anywhere - hardirq preempts poll and spins forever; high-confidence interrupt-context deadlock/DoS.
unresolved location=sound/parisc/harmony.c:300 conclusion=Read harmony.c around 300/336 and trace their callers to decide whether any process-context plain acquisition of h->lock races the plain hardirq acquisitions; if all non-irq paths use irqsave, classify safe.
unresolved location=drivers/staging/emxx_udc/emxx_udc.c:2329 conclusion=Classify each plain udc->lock site in emxx_udc.c by context; any process/softirq-context plain holder against the hardirq taker at 2329 is a reportable mixed-discipline defect.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/dec/tulip/winbond-840.c:1282 conclusion=Trace winbond-840.c lines 1127 and 1282 to their enclosing functions and call context; a process-context plain holder of np->lock against the hardirq taker at 1143 would confirm a defect.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/amd/7990.c:661 conclusion=Read 7990.c around 661, identify the enclosing function and its callers (open/tx_timeout/reset), and confirm or refute a process-context plain acquisition of lp->devlock against the hardirq side.
unresolved location=drivers/media/rc/ite-cir.c:233 conclusion=Trace ite-cir.c line 233 to its function and all callers; if any caller is a process-context LIRC ioctl path, the plain hardirq/plain process pair on dev->lock is a candidate defect.
unresolved location=sound/pci/intel8x0m.c:465 conclusion=Read intel8x0m.c around 465 and enumerate the callers of that function; a process-context caller taking chip->reg_lock plainly against the hardirq taker at 477 would confirm a defect.
coverage_gap=Handler-lock extraction resolved in-file lock usage for 1234 of 2790 irq registrations (354 lock sites, 157 distinct handler-plain locks); handlers defined in other files or registered via macros/indirect function pointers were not resolved or examined.
coverage_gap=Cross-indexing matched lock expressions only within the registering file; locks shared across files (exported helpers, &priv->lock vs &dev->lock aliases) could hide additional hardirq-shared pairs.
coverage_gap=request_threaded_irq sites were not split into primary hardirq handler vs thread_fn; non-NULL primary handlers and thread-context acquisitions of handler-shared locks were not separately audited.
coverage_gap=Legacy s02 facts f005/f021/f036 (softirq/timer/tasklet branches) were not cross-consulted to prioritize candidates shared with this hardirq branch.
